title: Now
dek: What's actually on my desk and in my ears right now. Not a highlight reel.

entries.heading: Building
entries.body: Polishing GRØD before a wider release. Adding a customised language model, private cloud computer, Cloudkit and Siri support. Oh and a puzzle game.

entries.heading: Reading
entries.body: Just finished *The Faith of Beasts*, by James S. A. Corey, the pen name behind The Expanse. It bangs.
